See *[*Vision & Growth Strategy*](https://www.notion.so/31167c87082c819f8981e314ba6ff86f)* for source of truth.* **Last regenerated:** 2026-03-16 **Stale:** YES — this page needs a full regeneration. Core facts below are updated but the detailed sections (Active Build Focus, Recent Changes) are from early March and don't reflect the SQS dual-profile redesign, capability quality audit, code audits, or language alignment work done March 13-16. Refer to the [Roadmap](https://www.notion.so/31c67c87082c819ca238c0ae01957a69) and Journal for current state. ## Current Vision Strale is the trust layer of the agent economy. One API call — `strale.do(task)` — gives AI agents access to capabilities they're missing at runtime. Three growth phases: Capability Marketplace (now) → Reputation Layer (Q3 2026) → Trust Standard (2027+). Strategic principle: grow with the giants, don't compete with them. Transaction intelligence is the compounding moat — data compounds, features don't. ## What's Live (as of 2026-03-16) - **229 active capabilities** across 12 categories, 27 countries (4 deactivated — see [Visibility Policy](https://www.notion.so/32567c87082c819b8d47fdecc0da7223)) - **Core API:** `POST /v1/do` with idempotency, dry_run, capability_slug override, optional max_price_cents - **Solutions:** 15 seed solutions across 6 categories. `/v1/solutions` and `/v1/solutions/:slug` endpoints live. Solution pages at [strale.dev/solutions](http://strale.dev/solutions) live and pulling from real data. - **Semantic suggest engine:** `POST /v1/suggest` live with Voyage AI embeddings + Claude Haiku re-ranking (DEC-20260303-E). Wired to SearchHero on /solutions. - **SQS dual-profile model:** Quality Profile (4 factors) + Reliability Profile (5 factors) + published 5×5 matrix → SQS confidence score + execution guidance. 1,215 test suites with adaptive scheduling, failure classification, auto-remediation. See [SQS Dual-Profile Architecture](https://www.notion.so/32467c87082c817cb456fc04485ec539). - **Trust display system:** Centralized rules in `trust-display.ts` — one chart (TrustBarChart), one calculation (calculatePassRate), one severity vocabulary (healthy/minor_issue/degraded/unhealthy), one narrative tone. Traffic light colors (≥90% green, 70-89% orange, \<70% red). Shared tooltip helpers across all surfaces. - **Prepaid wallet** via Stripe Checkout. €2 free trial credits. - **MCP server** (`strale-mcp` on npm) — discoverable by 300+ MCP clients. - **A2A Agent Cards** at `/.well-known/agent-card.json`. - **Smithery** registry listing live. - **Framework plugins:** `strale-semantic-kernel` (npm published). `langchain-strale` + `crewai-strale` built; PyPI upload pending. - [**strale.dev**](http://strale.dev) live — homepage restructured (11-section layout per DEC-20260303-G), solutions pages with quality dots + recommended sort + transparency badges, solution detail pages with trust card (hero metric + bar chart), quality narrative, "Extend this solution" section, "How we ensure quality" accountability section, code examples (TS/Python/cURL), known limitations, test results (collapsible, by-type breakdown, per-step quality). - **Web provider abstraction:** All 47 Browserless-dependent capabilities route through `web-provider.ts` with retry (exponential backoff + jitter), in-memory response cache (5-min TTL, 200 entries LRU), and provider-agnostic interface. Swedish-company-data has LLM fallback parsing. ## Merged Branches (both now on main) - `feat/solutions` — solutions DB, seed data, API endpoints, frontend types/hooks/pages ✅ - `feat/trust-pipeline` — quality capture, test runner, trust summaries, POST /v1/suggest ✅ ## Active Build Focus **D1 V1.5 Polish** (current phase — largely complete): - Trust display system: DONE (rules established, all components aligned) - Solution detail page UX: DONE (section reorder, progressive disclosure, quality narrative, extend section, accountability section) - Solution list page UX: DONE (quality dots, recommended sort, transparency tags, tooltips) - Capability detail page UX: DONE (trust card, quality badge, code examples with real data + example responses, "Used in solutions" cross-linking, transparency tags, test results (hidden when no data), accountability section, slug in tooltip, null-safe trust rendering) - Capability list page UX: DONE (client-side search, sort, 2-column grid, category pills, transparency tags, quality dots via batch endpoint, visual alignment with solutions, engaging H1 "What capabilities does your agent need?", "Or browse all capabilities" divider, duplicate category removed from cards, "Testing planned" fallback) - Test suite quality: DONE (72→94/98, web provider layer, test data audit) - Test infrastructure: DONE (506 suites for all 233 capabilities, test history endpoint with per-run drill-down, health state computation, auto-capture example outputs, adaptive scheduling, bar chart shows latest-run-per-day, cost-smart testing: dry-run schema tests FREE, regression baselines FREE, dependency health checks FREE, piggyback monitoring from real traffic FREE, automated capability onboarding hook, frontend displays all new test types) - Hardcoded data audit: DONE (6 fixes shipped, pre-launch refresh deferred) - Security audit: DONE (3 critical, 8 high, 11 medium all fixed, split CORS for public read-only endpoints) - SEO: DONE (unique meta descriptions for all 7 pages) > 📋 **For what’s next, see the **[**Roadmap**](https://www.notion.so/31c67c87082c819ca238c0ae01957a69)**.** Per the Notion Governance Protocol, this page describes what exists — the Roadmap is the single task list. ## Key Active Decisions

DEC-20260303-M Surface schema validation and transparency markers on homepage from Security page
## Phase 1 Revenue Streams - Per-call marketplace: €0.02–€1.00/call (high volume dependency) - Compliance & governance subscription: €200–500/month - Outcome business: €500–1,500/report ## Recent Changes - **2026-03-16:** Full code audit (58 findings) + capability quality audit (229 active, 0 upstream_broken) + website copy alignment (62→95+) + language guide established. See Journal for details. - **2026-03-15/16:** SQS dual-profile model deployed. Chromium EU West. Sprint 12A API migrations (ECB, Austrian, Spanish, Estonian). 4 capabilities deactivated. - **2026-03-13:** Adaptive Test Intelligence deployed. Failure classification engine, auto-remediation, adaptive scheduling. - **2026-03-08:** SQS upgraded to Constitution spec. Full test coverage (1,215 suites). Frontend SQS display. Stripe activated. - **2026-03-07:** Solution detail page full redesign shipped (Phases 1-3 + 2b + fixes). Zone A/B architecture, stacked code block with smart response preview (contextual field interpretation, field ordering), QualityGlance, StepQualityTable, narrative test summaries, error sanitization, progressive disclosure on limitations, platform evaluator language throughout. Dynamic step count in ComparisonTable. Cleanup prompt queued (UPSTREAM label, Internal tag, narrative count mismatch, bar colors). SQS Scoring Methodology spec created (last-N-runs, recency weighting, circuit breakers, cadence framework) — needs decision before implementation. Data source provenance queued as follow-up. Design System Color Tokens spec created. - **2026-03-06:** Test run endpoint resilience. `fetchTestRuns` returns empty data on 503 instead of throwing (TanStack Query treats as empty, not error). `TestRunLog` shows "temporarily unavailable" on non-503 errors, distinct from "no data yet" empty state. `useTestRuns` hook adds `retry: 1` for transient failures. - **2026-03-06 (cont.):** Test run audit log + metric consistency + capabilities audit (DEC-20260306-A through F). Major feature: replaced duplicate bar chart with chronological test run audit log with expandable failure details. Solution runs aggregate across all steps (HAVING COUNT \>= step_count). Fixed 6 metric consistency issues across all surfaces (timestamps, test counts, labels, formatters, color thresholds). Full capabilities detail page audit: added example output from test data, smart code example inputs, quality dot health awareness, fallback parameter descriptions, HTML sanitization in failure reasons, Known limitations section. Removed collapsible behavior from Test results (always visible). Pass rate as primary metric in run log. Multiple backend perf fixes. 6 decisions logged (DEC-20260306-A through F). \~15 commits across both repos. - **2026-03-05/06:** Marathon UX + quality + security + test infrastructure session (60+ prompts). **Reliability:** Test suite 72/98 → 94/98, web provider abstraction (47 capabilities), LLM fallback parsing. **Trust display system:** 4 centralized rules (one chart, one calculation, one severity vocabulary, one narrative tone). Quality narrative on recommendation card. Simplified typeahead (signal → interpretation → deep dive). quality_status in /v1/do responses. Bar chart shows latest-run-per-day (not daily average). **Solutions UX:** Quality dots, recommended sort, transparency tags, tooltips, "Extend this solution," "How we ensure quality" accountability section, section reorder, progressive disclosure, muted limitations, parallel execution explainer, neutral comparison crosses. **Capabilities UX (rebuilt):** Trust card, quality badge, code examples with real data + example responses, "Used in solutions" cross-linking, transparency tags (233 capabilities: 95 ai_generated, 3 mixed, 135 algorithmic), test results section, accountability section, client-side search replacing broken suggest API, sort options, 2-column grid, category pills, batch trust endpoint, visual alignment with solutions. **Test infrastructure:** Auto-generated 506 test suites for all 233 capabilities (schema + error handling per capability). Test history endpoint with per-run drill-down. Health state computation (new→unstable→recovering→stable→established). Auto-capture example outputs from first successful test runs. Test history log in frontend (lazy-loaded, expandable failure details). Health state + schedule transparency displayed in trust card. **Security audit:** Full audit of both repos — 3 critical (A2A auth bypass, SSRF protection, timing-safe admin), 8 high (hono upgrade, CORS restriction, body limits, spend cap, error boundary, npm audit), 11 medium all fixed. Split CORS (public read-only endpoints open, authenticated restricted). Vite proxy for Lovable preview. **Other:** Hardcoded data audit, €2 constant extracted, pipeline bugs fixed (bank-bic-lookup, sanctions fields), 7+ decisions logged, Trust UX Layers documented, Adaptive Test Scheduling spec documented. 7 decisions logged (DEC-20260305-A through G). - **2026-03-04:** Full workspace consolidation. Archived Product Strategy page. Marked 5 pre-pivot Feature Registry entries as cancelled. Updated Project Home with code-accurate build plan. - **2026-03-03:** Trust pipeline backend merged. POST /v1/suggest shipped. Homepage restructured. 11 decisions logged. - **2026-03-02:** Pricing framework and QA framework decided. Solutions seeded. Frontend stub pages built. - **2026-03-01:** Vision & Growth Strategy published as single source of truth. "}
